messages:
emma (Docs): FYI opened a docs PR for sealed-site airgap + registry mirror flow. Need quick eyes on HSM import steps, registry auth examples, and the offline bundle signing note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012 :wave:

rafael (Installer): skimmed it. two things: the mirror example uses containerd config v2 but our installer defaults to cri-o for sealed installs. should add a cri-o snippet or make the mirror section neutral.

meera (Security): security review: the KMS section calls out symmetric key rotation but doesn't specify policy update order for HSM-backed keys. we should explicitly say: update KMS key policy -> stage new key material -> import to HSM -> rotate. also call out that vendor HSMs may require PKCS#11 slot resets.

otto (PrivOps): added a small example for registry auth using token files and a local auth proxy. snippet:```ini
# /etc/registry-auth/token.conf
[auth]
mechanism = "file"
token_path = "/etc/redwood/registry-token"```

emma (Docs): nice. i'm going to add a short table mapping services->ports (control-plane, installer, kms, hsm, mirror) and a one-line nftables->iptables conversion note.

doc-lint-bot: link-check: 1 broken link detected (https://intranet.redwood.ai/network-ports -> 404). Recommend replacing with /docs/network/port-matrix or add a redirect.

rafael (Installer): tested installer in an isolated lab (dual-nic, internal-only). observations: 1) when using iptables-legacy we needed an explicit MASQUERADE rule for egress-proxy chaining; 2) the systemd unit for redwood-installer hit the default TimeoutStartSec on slow USB disks. patch in PR increases TimeoutStartSec=300. logs:```bash
Oct 12 10:15:02 sealed-installer systemd[1]: Starting redwood-installer...
Oct 12 10:19:58 sealed-installer redwood-installer[4123]: pulling mirror images...```

meera (Security): also add note about pkcs11 paths across distros: examples for ubuntu (/usr/lib/hsm/libpkcs11.so), rhel/centos (/usr/lib64/hsm/libpkcs11.so), sles (/opt/hsm/lib64/pkcs11.so). mention SELinux contexts for rhel family.

otto (PrivOps): confirmed the HSM role mapping example works with vendor-A and vendor-B. I suggested adding a small service-account snippet so customers can paste it:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: redwood-installer
  namespace: redwood
```

emma (Docs): pushing updates: port table, distro pkcs11 examples, cri-o mirror snippet, TimeoutStartSec change, and the registry token example. i'll fix the dead link (switch to /docs/network/port-matrix). tagging @meera @rafael for a final look. thanks :tada:

meera (Security): approving pending the SELinux note.

rafael (Installer): +1 from install team after cri-o snippet.

emma (Docs): merged after small lint and link fixes. will follow up with a short migration note for customers moving from iptables-legacy to nftables.
